body:
Thanks for your contribution and patience!

After careful consideration, I feel like this change goes in the right direction. Especially since I think we'd end up implementing something like this in one way or another to handle the new `.slnx` format.

It also avoids breaking compatibility by falling back to the old path when unable to find a matching solution. This was one of my concerns originally, but as you said in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98804#issuecomment-2453808460 I think you handled it pretty gracefully.

There's only a few things I would change, I think the processing of the solution files can be simplified somewhat. Other than that, it looks pretty good already.

Again, thank you for contributing to the .NET module and sorry for taking so long to review this PR. I'll move this PR to the 4.5 milestone, as we're currently in feature freeze for 4.4.
